errors.what: Crank rotates clockwise instead of counter-clockwise: from t=0 (pin B on +X axis) the crank pin moves below the pivot axis (t=0.33 at about -30 deg, t=1.00 at -90 deg, t=2.00 at 180 deg, t=3.00 at +90 deg), while the piston stays on +X. Link lengths (r=40, l=120), piston travel and assembly look correct.
